title: Term Life Insurance Accelerated Benefit: Months Set Aside Where Premium Is Paid Ahead
content:
For a Term Life Insurance terminal illness advance, the months to set aside are worked out from the premium months to cover by one of three methods, depending on the paid-to date on record:

- **Paid-to date after today, covering all of the premium months** — the whole months from today to the paid-to date are at least the premium months to cover: nothing is set aside.
- **Paid-to date after today, covering only part of them**: the whole months already paid (from today to the paid-to date) are taken off the premium months to cover.
- **Paid-to date not after today**: the premium months to cover are set aside as they are.

### Input - judgement - output (hypothetical, premium months to cover 6, today 10 May 2026)

| Paid-to date on record | Whole months from today | Months to set aside |
|---|---|---|
| 15 December 2026 | 7 | nothing |
| 15 August 2026 | 3 | 3 |
| 10 May 2026 | — (not after today) | 6 |
| 1 April 2026 | — (not after today) | 6 |
